# shopify_url_redirect (List Resource)

Lists the URL redirects of the store, 250 per request. Redirects whose stored path or target the resource's validators would reject are skipped and don't count toward the limit.

## Example Usage

```terraform
list "shopify_url_redirect" "legacy" {
  provider = shopify

  config {
    query = "path:\"/legacy\""
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `query` (String) A Shopify search filter, such as `path:"/old-page"` or `target:"/new-page"`, to import a large set in parts.
